credits: 3.0 Credit Hours (8-Week Accelerated Block, 6.0 Contact Hours/Week)
description: Comprehensive, hands-on instruction in enterprise AI workforce integration, agentic workflow automation, no-code and code-based tool orchestration, human-in-the-loop governance, and sovereign local AI deployment across production workplace environments.

assignment_groups.name: Workforce AI Capstone Project & Live Defense

learning_outcomes: CLO 1: Analyze enterprise business workflows to quantify ROI, labor impact, and feasibility for agentic AI automation.
CLO 2: Formulate enterprise governance charters applying NIST AI RMF and human-in-the-loop escalation gates to autonomous systems.
CLO 3: Rapidly prototype conversational and task-oriented agents using modern workplace platforms connected to live data sources.
CLO 4: Architect multi-step no-code and low-code workflows (n8n/Relay/Zapier) that combine LLM reasoning with deterministic APIs and automated error recovery.
CLO 5: Implement programmatic tool-calling agents in Python using robust Pydantic schemas, HTTP/API data contracts, and automated validation tests.
CLO 6: Build persistent, stateful multi-turn agents using LangGraph and SQLite checkpoints with supervisor approval gates.
CLO 7: Instrument agent execution telemetry with LangSmith to evaluate accuracy, drift, latency, and prompt injection resilience.
CLO 8: Deploy and benchmark sovereign local AI models and agents on Intel PC hardware (Ollama, OpenVINO, SQLite, FAISS) ensuring zero cloud data leakage.
CLO 9: Defend an end-to-end workforce AI implementation in an executive capstone presentation demonstrating commercial viability, architecture, and risk controls.
